quotes.location: SECTION 5.4 - REQUIREMENTS FOR ANSWERS TO QUESTIONS, page 36

quotes.text: The LFS allows interviewers to take answers to questions by proxy if a respondent is unavailable. This is usually from another related adult who is a member of the same household, although there are exceptions to this rule:
checks to ensure each household has a household reference person (HRP)

assessments.reasoning: The survey documentation uses the neutral term 'Household Reference Person (HRP)' as the anchor category (Section 6.3 and Section 15 Table 15.1), satisfying neutral_anchor_term. However, the text does not explicitly state a full selection rule for choosing the HRP (only listing the variable HRPID as 'Whether accommodation is owned/rented in respondent’s name' without defining tie-breakers or full selection criteria), so explicit_selection_rule and rule_not_sex_age_authority are false. For respondent_separate_or_any_adult, Section 5.5 confirms that answers may be given by proxy by 'another related adult who is a member of the same household', establishing that any knowledgeable adult may answer.
